camel_example: aliyun dypnsapi CreateSchemeConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Platform Android --SchemeName 'APP测试方案' --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a unified authentication scheme and retrieves the scheme code. A unified authentication scheme identifies the authentication scenario for an app. Typically, one scheme corresponds to one app package name and package signature
description_zh: 融合认证方案用于标识App下的认证场景，一般一个认证方案对应一个App包名、包签名。调用本接口创建融合认证方案并获取方案Code
kebab_example: aliyun dypnsapi create-scheme-config --scheme-name 'APP测试方案' --platform Android --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSchemeConfig

parameters.help_en: The scheme name. The name can contain only Chinese and English letters and must be up to 10 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 方案名称，由中、英文字母构成，长度限制为10个字符
parameters.name: scheme_name

parameters.help_en: The platform to which the scheme applies
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en: The name of the app for the scheme. The name can contain only Chinese and English letters and must be up to 20 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用方案的App名称，由中、英文字母构成，长度限制20个字符
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The package name. This parameter is required when Platform is set to Android. The package name can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.) and must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 包名，Platform为Android时必选。由数字、字母、短划线（-）、下划线或点组成，长度限制为1~128个字符
parameters.name: android_package_name

parameters.help_en: The package signature. This parameter is required when Platform is set to Android. The signature can contain digits and letters and must be 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 包签名，Platform为Android时必选。由数字和字母组成，长度为32个字符
parameters.name: android_package_sign

parameters.help_en: The bundle ID. This parameter is required when osType is set to iOS. The bundle ID can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.) and must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: BundleID，osType为iOS时必选。由数字、字母、短划线（-）、下划线或点组成，长度限制为1~128个字符
parameters.name: ios_bundle_id

parameters.help_en: Reserved. H5 schemes are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 保留字段，暂不支持H5方案
parameters.name: h5_url

parameters.help_en: Reserved. H5 schemes are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 保留字段，暂不支持H5方案
parameters.name: h5_origin
